title: Octopus intelligence may be related to never-before-seen mutation
summary: Researchers have discovered a never-before-seen genetic mutation in octopuses that may explain their remarkable intelligence. This unique mutation appears to help octopuses build proteins more accurately, potentially contributing to their advanced neural development and cognitive abilities.
problem_solved: Understanding the genetic basis behind octopus intelligence and their extraordinary cognitive abilities.
why_valuable: This discovery provides new insights into the evolutionary origins of intelligence and could inform our understanding of neural development across species.
